description: A random forest on SPY price features, trained on the earlier half.
correction_reason: train_test_split(shuffle=True) was written without a random_state, so it drew from the global RNG and the case disagreed with itself: 40 unseeded runs of the unchanged file span sharpe 3.03 to 4.75 (median 3.80). That is wider than most of the leak effects this suite measures, so a before/after delta on this case was partly a coin flip. random_state=0 was chosen a priori, not searched for: it yields 3.7398, the 45th percentile of that distribution and adjacent to its median. The same keyword is added to clean.py, where shuffle=False makes it inert, so the two variants still differ by exactly the one fragment the L10 recipe substitutes and rule 5's round-trip is unaffected. The leak mechanism, its ground-truth line 25, its type and its classification are unchanged; only the draw is now fixed.
